## Pest control

- Hub: https://pestcontrolinfra.co.in/pest-control
- Home: https://pestcontrolinfra.co.in/
- Hindi: https://pestcontrolinfra.co.in/pest-control/deemak-keede-ka-ilaaj-lucknow (दीमक / कीड़े का इलाज लखनऊ; also referred to as deemak treatment and keede maarne wali service)

DVS Pest Control treats homes and businesses in Lucknow and Uttar Pradesh. Listed services include cockroach control (odorless herbal gel, described as suitable for kitchens, children and pets), subterranean termite / deemak treatment (drill-fill-seal barrier along walls and foundations, 5-year written warranty and annual inspection checks), rodent and rat control, mosquito fogging and larvicide, general pest control, bed bugs, ants, lizards, bees, bird netting, and industrial or grain fumigation (phosphine or methyl bromide, FSSAI and plant-quarantine certificates as listed; site survey required).

Published Lucknow apartment rates (1 BHK to 5 BHK) include general pest control ₹899 / ₹1,300 / ₹1,600 / ₹1,800 / ₹2,100; cockroach ₹999–₹1,999; ant ₹949–₹2,099; termite ₹3,249–₹8,500; mosquito ₹999–₹3,300; bed bug ₹1,399–₹4,499; lizard ₹900–₹2,500; bees ₹1,299–₹2,399; bird netting ₹1,300–₹5,300. Service-card starting rates include cockroach ₹1,499, rodent ₹1,999, mosquito ₹1,299, termite ₹6,500, fumigation ₹8,500. The final price is confirmed after inspection.

A separate pre-construction anti-termite package is not listed. Builders and new-building enquiries are handled from the published termite method, confirmed after inspecting the site: https://pestcontrolinfra.co.in/pest-control/pre-construction-anti-termite-lucknow

Area pages describe service areas in Lucknow. They do not claim a local office or completed jobs in that locality.

Localities: Gomti Nagar, Indira Nagar, Aliganj, Hazratganj, Alambagh, Sarojini Nagar, Jankipuram, Vikas Nagar, Ashiyana, Chinhat, Aminabad, Rajajipuram, Mahanagar, Telibagh, Vrindavan Yojna, Chowk, Charbagh, Gomti Nagar Extension, Sushant Golf City, Kanpur Road, Faizabad Road, Rajendra Nagar, Nishatganj, Kursi Road, Sitapur Road, Para, Krishna Nagar, Shaheed Path, Amausi, Jankipuram Extension.

## House drawings

- Page: https://pestcontrolinfra.co.in/drawings
- Hindi page: https://pestcontrolinfra.co.in/drawings/ghar-ka-naksha
- 2D AutoCAD house plans, sections and elevations, including plumbing and electrical drawings: ₹6 per sq ft of built-up area.
- 3D front elevation: a flat ₹6,000 for any size, when existing drawings are available or when the 2D set is also being drafted.
- Delivered online as DWG and PDF files, anywhere in India, in 10 days.
- The fee includes up to 2 to 3 major revisions and 4 to 5 minor revisions.
- Drawings by Amrish Singh, B.Tech Civil, M.Tech Structural Engineering, Lucknow.
- Sample drawings are shown on the drawings pages. Plans are drafted to the plot size and notes the client sends; they are not ready-made catalogue plans.
- Structural design and municipal approval filing are not included in the standard 2D fee.
- Vastu pages give general, commonly cited guidance only. They are not a site-specific Vastu study.
